study.question: Does compact association between elapsed gap and the directed source/destination behavior pair add useful information beyond the same per-impression gap and behavior-transition margins, on the unchanged visible history?
study.hypothesis: Observation: the actual direct gap branch pools action/target states away, while the transition branch retains action transitions without gap; timing and symmetric serial branches retain times without actions. Existing source can therefore alias histories that differ in which behavior transition has a short versus long gap. Hypothesis: a compact H[gap,source action,destination action] preserves useful behavior-specific pace without the 4096-dimensional target/equality context expansion of the unsuccessful local_all branch. This information-loss mechanism is testable; its predictive utility is unestablished. The failed run histogram is not retained as an active signal: whole incumbent run_mode=zero is fixed. Measured preceding run study: observed AUC0.6307642908/Logloss0.1928470831,composition0.6308151751/0.1927391270,zero0.6308886184/0.1928712234,all seed42. Observed loses0.0001243276 AUC versus zero while slightly improving Logloss; neither run-specific utility nor general temporal failure is established. Serial observed0.6304721940,symmetric0.6307758870,zero0.6302757284 likewise limits a directional chronology explanation. The new action-linked branch asks a different question.

No exact author reproduction or priority claim.

Author README verifies history category/brand/behavior rather than item identity. Publisher paper remains unavailable; no full-paper mechanism claim. New branch uses only available action and age columns, with complete-pair singleton support inherited unchanged.

study.proposed_difference: Append H[b,g,s,d] with4 inherited gap bins (<=60,<=3600,<=86400,>86400 seconds),4 source and4 destination actions on the exact supported adjacent subsequence. Joint input is log1p(H)/log129 flattened64. Matched control replaces raw H by H[g,:,:].sum * H[:,s,d].sum / total within EACH impression, preserving gap and directed-action-pair margins before transformation, then uses identical64->16->1 head. Both variants execute both alternatives and preserve parent source. No extra target-match state, equality channel, fitted statistics or new event enters the branch.
predictions: The raw table agrees with an independent scalar oracle and sums to max(n_supported-1,0); its gap and action-pair margins agree with inherited gap/transition counts. Product preserves these margins including empty cases.

A constructed same-parent witness has equal event/action counts,age buckets,action-transition margins,gap histograms,timing tables and directed serial-gap table, but different joint action-gap tables. Product features and whole-parent logits should agree within float tolerance. This demonstrates representation difference, not efficacy.

If association is useful, joint should improve full validation AUC over marginal under the same recipe; report Logloss,paired seed variation and cost too. Improvements only versus historical parent do not isolate association.

Exploratory host history/action slices and first512 diagnostics describe support. Long histories dominate (3026583/3234051 exposures), so inspect empty/short groups without claiming significance or new confirmatory bins.

Implementation acceptance limits, fixed before host execution: exact integer count/oracle/conservation checks; raw float32 product-margin discrepancies <=1e-3 counts on diagnostic rows; finite fraction=1,zero-input residual exactly0. Witness joint feature gap>0.1,marginal gap<1e-6,whole-parent logit difference<=1e-5. Any larger error requires source review and is not scientific counterevidence. These numerical thresholds do not define predictive efficacy; compare full validation AUC and seed dispersion without a post-hoc significance threshold.
falsifiers: Oracle/conservation errors beyond float accumulation tolerance, nonfinite logits/diagnostics, changed parent source or changed information/optimizer boundary invalidate the implementation comparison.

Joint fails to improve marginal, or any difference reverses across paired seeds: no supported predictive benefit for this compact association. Marginal benefit alone supports added readout/margins, not association.
The witness fails to separate joint or preserve replacement/parent: the asserted aliasing argument is wrong and must be revised before host execution.
The smaller head does not improve measured quality/cost relative to existing references: no efficiency gain, even if an AUC increase occurs.
alternative_explanations: Large context table failed because of capacity/optimization/sparsity, not because action-gap information is useless; compact reparameterization is a discriminating but nonexhaustive retry.
log1p of observed and fractional product tables changes norms,sparsity and transformed margins; matched raw margins/parameters do not remove this scale confound.
Single-seed checkpoint selection,validation reuse across25 rounds,host nondeterminism and training interaction can explain small AUC changes. No significance or global novelty claim.
Filtering tied/missing-field events and128-event censoring creates supported-subsequence gaps rather than raw-log adjacency; behavior-specific rates may reflect support selection.
Candidate-supplied diagnostics cover first512 impressions only; they cannot establish full validation mechanism prevalence or independent efficacy. Static snapshot as-of dates are undocumented.
A pair-conditioned gap count does not identify causal behavior effects; it can proxy overall engagement or activity.
